description: Get the hosted checkout URL for an offer (by offer name or slug). Paste it anywhere — it works immediately. ALWAYS pass utm_source (plus utm_campaign and utm_content) when the seller says where the link is going — an email, a video, a post, an affiliate. Meta and Google attach their own click ids, but every other channel arrives untagged and is reported forever as 'direct'. This cannot be fixed after the fact: by the time anyone reads the report, the information was never recorded. Use the same utm_campaign across one push, and vary utm_content per message so they can be compared.

utm_campaign.description: Which push, e.g. jul-promo — use the SAME value everywhere in one campaign

utm_content.description: Which specific message or creative, e.g. day1, replay, carousel-b — this is what lets the seller compare them later

utm_medium.description: How: email, social, organic, paid, dm

utm_source.description: Where the link is going: kit, youtube, newsletter, instagram, affiliate-name…

name: get_checkout_link
title: Get checkout link
